# Wait for fake SMTP data before checking forwarded content

test_imapFilterActions.js triggers a forwarding action through setupTest, then waits for the fake SMTP daemon post before reading its contents. Folder-update completion alone did not make that field available: the Bug report showed msgData undefined. The same SMTP predicate remains in fixed accepted source. This narrows the wait to the state used by the next assertions; the helper still retains a separate200ms delay and no run here proves all intermittent failures fixed.

Scope: Scoped EWS and mail filter contracts.
